regions.name: Fort McMurray boreal forest
regions.story: Boreal crown fires, including the May 2016 Horse River fire and the 2023 record season.

regions.name: Dhaka brick-kiln belt
regions.story: Thousands of brick kilns fire every dry season (Nov–Apr). Static heat sources must be separated from vegetation fires.

regions.name: Chilecito, La Rioja
regions.story: Sparse, episodic mountain and scrub fires: a low-count region where sensor changes dominate raw trends.

regions.name: Northern California
regions.story: Wildland–urban interface fires: Camp (2018), August Complex and North Complex (2020), Dixie (2021).

regions.name: Niger Delta gas flares
regions.story: Persistent oil-field gas flares: thermal anomalies that are not vegetation fires.

regions.name: Paraná Delta wetlands
regions.story: Wetland and island fires, including the record 2020 and 2022 seasons; includes Predelta National Park.

regions.name: Punjab–Haryana crop residue burning
regions.story: Post-harvest rice stubble burning (Oct–Nov) and wheat residue (Apr–May) drive smog over the Indo-Gangetic Plain.

regions.name: Rondônia deforestation arc
regions.story: Dry-season (Jul–Oct) clearing fires along the Amazon arc of deforestation.

regions.name: South-east Australia
regions.story: The 2019–20 Black Summer megafires in New South Wales and Victoria.
